source_claim: The official Shugo Chara! anime character pages identify the named cast members as characters in the series; official episode titles and licensed series goods also explicitly identify the Amulet transformations.
notes: The official TV anime character page (https://shugo-chara.com/character/) profiles Hinamori Amu, Fujisaki Nadeshiko, Fujisaki Nagihiko (explicitly stating Nagihiko is Nadeshiko's true identity), Hoshina Utau, Hotori Tadase, Mashiro Rima, Tsukiyomi Ikuto, and Yuiki Yaya. The official episode catalog (https://shugo-chara.com/story/shugo-chara.html) names the transformation episodes 'Character Transformation! Amulet Spade!', '... Amulet Clover!', and '... Amulet Dia!'; the official series goods catalog (https://shugo-chara.com/goods/toy_game.html) names Amulet Heart and Amulet Spade series character goods, while official licensed goods materials list the four Amulet forms under Shugo Chara! (https://prtimes.jp/a/?c=16064&f=d16064-8232-14ed6605e252b4cfec1499fe11e46669&r=8232). These establish all four transformation identities and the eight roster identities within the Shugo Chara! copyright.
